reasons.plausibility: The proposed interface‐serration mechanism to impede crack propagation and increase strain hardening is scientifically grounded in known microstructural toughening strategies for lamellar alloys.
reasons.testability: It can be directly tested by applying the post‐processing treatment, verifying interface morphology changes, and measuring mechanical properties to see if they improve as predicted.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a clear, plausible route to addressing the known limitation of room‐temperature ductility in lamellar high‐entropy alloys through a potentially scalable microstructural engineering approach.
